parameters: \bThank you! Those goons were nothing but bad trouble.

\bLostelle went off towards Bond Bridge a while ago.
\rThree Island is actually the most populous of the islands here.
\rBut I wouldn't want to see goons like those bikers here again.
\bFrom this day on, this island belongs to us!
\bI'm going to train my Doduo in the Berry Forest.

\bWe're asking you to go back to Kanto!
